passive.name: Thundersnow
passive.text: Below half HP, at the start of each Round a marked lane on your side is struck by lightning at the start of the next Round. Heavier armor draws more of the bolt.

notes: Below half HP a lane on your side glows: lightning lands there at the start of the next Round. Step out of the lane.
Whiteout darkens the board for a short while: your heroes reach only as deep as the light allows. A lightning strike in the dark lights the board (Thunderflash).
